meta.name: azure-messaging
meta.description: Troubleshoot and resolve issues with Azure Messaging SDKs for Event Hubs and Service Bus. Covers connection failures, authentication errors, message processing issues, and SDK configuration problems. WHEN: event hub SDK error, service bus SDK issue, messaging connection failure, AMQP error, event processor host issue, message lock lost, message lock expired, lock renewal, lock renewal batch, send timeout, receiver disconnected, SDK troubleshooting, azure messaging SDK, event hub consumer, service bus queue issue, topic subscription error, enable logging event hub, service bus logging, eventhub python, servicebus java, eventhub javascript, servicebus dotnet, event hub checkpoint, event hub not receiving messages, service bus dead letter, batch processing lock, session lock expired, idle timeout, connection inactive, link detach, slow reconnect, session error, duplicate events, offset reset, receive batch.

copy.tagline: 排查并修复Azure消息服务SDK的连接与处理故障
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在使用Azure事件中心或服务总线时遇到SDK错误需要快速定位
copy.tagline_en: Troubleshoot and fix Azure messaging SDK connection and processing issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you encounter SDK errors with Azure Event Hubs or Service Bus and need quick diagnosis

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会针对 Azure Event Hubs 和 Service Bus 的 SDK 问题做排查，包括连接失败、认证错误、消息处理、锁丢失等，并借助资源健康检查和文档搜索给出原因分析与修复建议。
howto.when: 当用户提出 Event Hub 或 Service Bus 的 SDK 报错、连接失败、认证问题，或消息锁丢失、超时、重连异常等排查需求时触发。

say.text: 帮我排查一下 Event Hubs SDK 连接失败的原因。
say.note: Claude 会按流程检查资源健康、错误信息并给修复建议。

say.text: Service Bus 消息锁过期了怎么处理？
say.note: Claude 会查找相关文档并给出锁续期等解决方案。

say.text: 如何给 Event Hub 客户端开启日志？

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will troubleshoot Azure Event Hubs and Service Bus SDK issues—covering connection, authentication, message processing, lock loss, etc.—and use Azure resource checks and documentation search to give root-cause analysis and fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user reports Event Hub or Service Bus SDK errors, connection failures, authentication errors, message lock loss, timeouts, reconnection issues, or similar messaging troubleshooting requests.

say_en.text: Help me troubleshoot why the Event Hubs SDK connection fails.
say_en.note: Claude will check resource health and error details, then suggest a fix.

say_en.text: How do I handle a Service Bus message lock that expired?
say_en.note: Claude will find relevant docs and offer lock renewal solutions.

say_en.text: How can I enable logging for the Event Hub client?
say_en.note: Claude will search Microsoft Learn and explain logging setup.
